name: Yakushidou Amane
source:
"Tsk, how slow of you. You'd like for me to record your dying face, you filthy pig?"

The biological daughter of the Yakushido family, and Shii's step-sister. A cruelly sadistic girl, who relishes in other people's suffering. Despite her beautiful face, she spews nothing but filthy words. She takes great pleasure in photographing the misfortune of others, collecting images of them, wounded and miserable. She holds a particular fondness towards [url=https://vndb.org/c161945]Shii[/url], and is enamored by her misfortune, holding it as her most beloved treasure.

Flower: Gentian
Bloom Factor: [???]
Magic: [???]

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/Amane_Yakushido]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
[Description taken from the [url=https://https://mahoumura.com/]Official Site[/url].]
